description: Home-built Bensen autogyro; photographed in the FAP museum collection at Las Palmas in December 2010 and listed by aviationmuseum.eu as displayed at the Castillo Rospigliosi site. Presence at the Castillo not independently dated.

Stearman trainer listed by aviationmuseum.eu at the Castillo Rospigliosi site, serial quoted as 126 or 168 (unresolved, so left blank). FAP Stearman N2S-5 126 was photographed at Las Palmas in May 2008; a second Stearman wore OB-I-835 in 1997.

Cockpit/nose section only. Canberra B(I)12 204 was photographed complete at Las Palmas in February 1997; aviationmuseum.eu lists the cockpit at the Castillo Rospigliosi museum. Needs on-site confirmation.
